hero.title: FabLab Projects
hero.subtitle: Innovating at the Intersection of Community & Technology

ecosystem.title: Ecosystem Role
ecosystem.desc: The FabLab serves as the **Community Engine**, fostering a tribe of makers and early adopters. It validates ideas through direct engagement and educational initiatives.

s1.title: 1. Problem
s1.desc: There is a huge gap between university theory and industrial practice. SMEs struggle to adopt Industry 4.0 technologies due to a lack of practical know-how, while students and makers lack access to professional equipment to prototype their ideas.

s2.title: 2. Solution
s2.desc: A FabLab as a local innovation hub: physical space with open access to 3D printers, CNC, laser cutting, and electronics. Not just machines, but an open-source knowledge-sharing ecosystem where real problems are solved by building functional prototypes.

s3.title: 3. Key Results
s3.i3: Impact: 12 startups incubated or supported in the MVP phase.

s4.title: 4. Business Model
s4.i2: Workshops and training courses (B2C and B2B).
s4.i3: Rapid R&D consultancy for local companies.

s5.title: 5. Tech & Infrastructure
s5.i1: Additive: Diversified FDM farm, SLA for fine details.
s5.i2: Subtractive: Desktop CNC for PCB and wood/aluminum milling.

s6.title: 6. Status & Roadmap
s6.status: Status: Consolidated hub and regional reference point.
s6.i1: Focus 2026: Expansion towards bio-fabrication and sustainable materials.
s6.i2: Integration: Creation of a local node for distributed recycling (Precious Plastic).

s7.title: 7. My Role
s7.i1: Design and setup of the technical laboratory infrastructure.
s7.i2: Development of training programs and technical mentorship for members.
s7.i3: Managing partnerships with institutions and local entities.

s8.title: 8. Sustainability (ESG)
s8.i1: Circular Learning: Promoting the 'Repair over Replace' philosophy.
s8.i2: Inclusivity: Dedicated STEM programs for underrepresented categories in tech.
s8.i3: Local Production: Reduced logistics thanks to zero-km fabrication.
